note: CH-5 (Dart half): quokka_android's shape. The project's Dio clients are built with `BaseOptions(baseUrl: Env.apiBaseUrl)`, a getter returning '$scheme://$prodApiHost/api', so every root-relative dio call of that project is served under '/api'. The endpoint fold prefixes them (ENDPOINT_HIT `prefix` / `prefix_from`), so they pair EXACT with the gin routes; `BaseOptions(baseUrl: retry.baseUrl)` copies an existing base and is ignored. A generic call `dio.get<dynamic>('/x')` (selector(.get) selector(<T>) selector(args)) is an ENDPOINT at all. quokka_android: 18 plain + 25 generic dio calls.
